entries.title: Scheduled database write amplification repaired
entries.summary: Scheduled WordPress archive and civic-wire refreshes now treat unchanged records as no-ops instead of repeatedly rewriting retained data. WordPress synchronization writes only changed or removed publications, while RSS and weather refreshes deactivate only current items that have actually left a source and update retained items only when their public content changes. The Learning portal now identifies its 9,000-unit display as a separate Workers AI allowance and explicitly states that it does not measure D1 database operations. Existing publications, ticker history, civic records, and the certified-citizen population were preserved. All 83 release tests passed before publication.

changes: Stopped unchanged WordPress synchronization cycles from deleting and recreating the complete retained publication archive
Limited WordPress database writes to changed publications, removed publications, and low-frequency synchronization health markers
Limited RSS deactivation to currently displayed items that are absent from the latest source response
Prevented unchanged retained RSS and weather items from receiving redundant updates
Clarified that the 9,000-unit Learning display measures the separate Workers AI protective allowance rather than D1 operations
Preserved publication content, ticker history, civic records, server-side authorization, and the certified-citizen population
